## [NARC-1](https://nittany-amateur-radio-club.github.io/station/narc1.html)

- ICOM IC-7610 160-6m 100 W transceiver
- Elecraft KPA-1500 amplifier with ATU
- PC with dual monitors
- ICOM SM-30 desk mic
- Footswitch
- Full [software suite](https://nittany-amateur-radio-club.github.io/station/narc2.html#software-summary)

## [NARC-2](https://nittany-amateur-radio-club.github.io/station/narc2.html)

- [FlexRadio Flex 6400M](https://nittany-amateur-radio-club.github.io/station/flex-6400M.html) 160-6m 100 W transceiver
- Elecraft KPA-1500 amplifier with ATU
- PC with dual monitors
- Yaesu desk mic
- Footswitch
- Full [software suite](https://nittany-amateur-radio-club.github.io/station/narc2.html#software-summary)

## {background-iframe="https://nittany-amateur-radio-club.github.io/field-day/"}

---

- Saturday, June 22 - Sunday, June 23 (2:00 PM EDT - 2:00 PM EDT)
- NARC station
  - Class 2 (transmitters) D (Delta), [home/permanent station on mains power](http://www.arrl.org/field-day-rules) 
  - 100 W max
  - W3YA callsign
- Dedicated (bonus) VHF+ station (W3SWL)
- Food & drink
  
## Survey Results

- [Attendees](https://nittany-amateur-radio-club.github.io/field-day/planning.html#attending-and-operating)
- [Modes](https://nittany-amateur-radio-club.github.io/field-day/planning.html#modes)
- [Volunteers](https://nittany-amateur-radio-club.github.io/field-day/planning.html#volunteering)
- <https://nittany-amateur-radio-club.github.io/field-day/>

## New this year

- Field/portable station at Jo Hays Vista
  - Sat 2p-5p; Sun 11p-2p
  - Either 1A (W3GA) or alternative transmitter for W3YA
  - FM + linear satellite set-up?
  - Get on the air (GOTA) station?
- Inviting 2m and 70cm simplex QSOs from MS 150 operators or others in the valley

---

- Rotating Yagis!
  - [Green Heron rotator controllers](https://www.greenheronengineering.com/product/rotator-controller-rt-21/) for Mosely antennas (20m-10m)
  - *Coming soon*: Control rotators from NARC1 and NARC2 (thanks, K0LO)
- New logging software ([ACLog](https://www.n3fjp.com/aclog.html) by N3FJP)
  - N3LI spearheading
- New [Halibut Electronics audio interface ](https://electronics.halibut.com/product-category/ham/hhi) for NARC1

<script>
  // htmlwidgets need to know to resize themselves when slides are shown/hidden.
  // Fire the "slideenter" event (handled by htmlwidgets.js) when the current
  // slide changes (different for each slide format).
  (function () {
    // dispatch for htmlwidgets
    function fireSlideEnter() {
      const event = window.document.createEvent("Event");
      event.initEvent("slideenter", true, true);
      window.document.dispatchEvent(event);
    }

    function fireSlideChanged(previousSlide, currentSlide) {
      fireSlideEnter();

      // dispatch for shiny
      if (window.jQuery) {
        if (previousSlide) {
          window.jQuery(previousSlide).trigger("hidden");
        }
        if (currentSlide) {
          window.jQuery(currentSlide).trigger("shown");
        }
      }
    }

    // hookup for slidy
    if (window.w3c_slidy) {
      window.w3c_slidy.add_observer(function (slide_num) {
        // slide_num starts at position 1
        fireSlideChanged(null, w3c_slidy.slides[slide_num - 1]);
      });
    }

  })();
</script>
